name: ML
description: Closing line value for moneyline bets

name: SPR
description: Closing line value for spread bets

name: O/U
description: Closing line value for over/under totals

name: Color
description: Team primary color

name: Region
description: Team geographic region

name: Mascot
description: Team mascot animal or nickname

name: Conference
description: Team conference affiliation

name: Large Stake
description: Triggered when 3 or more units are wagered on a single bet

name: Consensus Color
description: Triggered when all bets on a slate share the same color

name: Line Shopper
description: Adds +0.10 decimal odds to every bet

name: Off the Board
description: Adds +0.15 odds to your first bet each round

name: Steam Chaser
description: Favorites (odds under 2.00) get +0.30 odds

name: Longshot Larry
description: Underdogs (odds 2.00+) get +0.75 odds

name: Ladder
description: +0.05 odds per win this round; resets each round

name: The Buyback
description: Winning bets settle at x1.25 odds

name: Ticket Stub
description: +3 stake on every bet at no cost to balance

name: The Grinder
description: +2 flat units of profit on each winning bet

name: Overweight
description: Your largest bet each round gets +10 stake

name: House Money
description: While balance is at or above the threshold, +8 stake to all bets

name: Whale
description: x1.5 payout on any single bet staking 50+ units

name: The Closer
description: Beat the closing line on a bet to gain 1 CLV card

name: Sharp Money
description: Every winning underdog grants a CLV card

name: Tout
description: Your first CLV card each round is duplicated

name: Market Maker
description: End of round, gain 1 CLV card per 3 bets placed

name: Hometown Hero
description: Pin one team; its bets get +0.20 odds

name: Bandwagon
description: +0.10 odds per different team you have won with this round

name: Rivalry Week
description: Division or rivalry matchups pay x1.3

name: Franchise Player
description: Pin one team; each win with them permanently adds +0.05 odds to that team

name: Push Protection
description: Pushes and voids grant +5 units instead of a flat refund

name: Rake Back
description: Gain 2 units every time you place a bet

name: Vig Cutter
description: Losing bets refund 20% of stake to balance

name: Bankroll Baron
description: +15 units to balance at end of round

name: Compounder
description: End of round, +1 unit per 10 units in balance (interest, cap 25)

name: Hot Hand
description: +0.10 odds per consecutive win; resets on a loss

name: Buzzer Beater
description: The last bet you place each round settles at x2 odds

name: Parlay Prophet
description: Each leg in a parlay adds +0.20 to the combined odds

name: Hedge Lord
description: Bet both sides of a game to give both sides +0.40 odds

name: Lock of the Day
description: Name one bet your Lock: x2 odds, but lose 15 units if it loses

name: Tilt
description: +0.15 permanent odds on every loss, but lose 5 units per loss

name: Bad Beat Kid
description: When a winning bet flips to a loss, gain 50 units

name: Wiseguy
description: Copies the effect of the Edge to its left

name: The Regular
description: Retriggers every bet once; all Edge effects apply twice

name: Degenerate
description: x3 odds on all bets, but you cannot skip a round and must stake at least 50% of balance each round
